Step-by-step diagram of the iodine test for starch in a leaf, in six numbered panels in two rows. 1: a leaf in a beaker of boiling water over a Bunsen flame. 2: the flame turned off. 3: the leaf in a boiling tube of ethanol standing in the beaker of hot water (water bath), the ethanol turning green. 4: the now pale leaf being dipped in a beaker of warm water. 5: the leaf spread flat on a white tile. 6: iodine solution being added with a dropper, the leaf turning blue-black.
